nodes.label: Generic Document/File Glyph
nodes.rationale: Minimal 16x16 monochrome (#666) vector glyph of a document/page with a folded corner. Represents the generic 'file' concept in UI; no brand or domain-specific meaning, deliberately neutral so it can be used as a placeholder anywhere a file/document icon is needed.

nodes.label: Next.js Starter Template Asset Family
nodes.rationale: file.svg co-resides in /public with globe.svg, next.svg, vercel.svg, and window.svg — the default placeholder icons shipped by create-next-app. They exist to give new projects immediately-usable static UI icons with no licensing or branding concerns.
